title: CSV warnings must survive failures without duplication
answers: Why does read_csv emit the converter and dtype warning twice?
Must parallel CSV warnings still appear when gathering raises?
Who emits warnings when a parallel CSV worker fails?
body:
Invariant: When a chunk fails and serial parsing takes over, warnings must appear once; enforced by pandas/tests/io/parser/test_parallel_read.py:test_parallel_worker_exception_falls_back_to_serial.
Scope: The same requirement covers warnings from the Python layer during name inference, enforced by pandas/tests/io/parser/test_parallel_read.py:test_parallel_fallback_does_not_repeat_python_layer_warning.
Exception path: A gather error that escapes without a serial read must still emit collected warnings once, enforced by pandas/tests/io/parser/test_parallel_read.py:test_parallel_gather_exception_still_warns.
Consequence: Changing failure handling without preserving these paths can duplicate warnings or lose them when an exception escapes.
applies: Warning handling during parallel read_csv fallback and escaping gather exceptions.
